# Platform overview

## Integrations

I need you to slide kafka to the top edge. Before that, add a title named kafka please. Then okay so clone the title. Lets insert a white task in the lower right and then put a triangle in the center please.

Scale the rectangle to medium. Before that, can you sketch a rectangle inside the triangle and then okay so connect the task to the rectangle. Please slide the rectangle a third of the way to the left edge.

Okay so scale the rectangle to large. After that, i need you to scale the rectangle to large.

Could you copy the rectangle left of the task. Also, i need you to rename the triangle to ledger.

Please do not slide ledger above the white task and then link the white task to the triangle please. Also, lets place a service on the left side. Lets shrink the task.

Would you link the triangle to the task with a teal connector and then please copy the triangle. Encrypt the gateway. Can you remove it. Then could you connect ledger and the task with a connector, and now make it blue.

## User accounts

I want you to add a red ellipse. Scale ledger to medium. Then can you shift the task to the top edge, and lets slide the task a third of the way to the top edge. After that, scale the service to large please.

Now on the left side , create a thin task, but never drag the second task a third of the way to the left edge. Then i want you to slide the service 5 px left.

I want you to resize the service to small. Lets turn the ellipse teal.

Now draw a start in the top right. Now duplicate the start on the left side, and okay so join the first task to the second task, but i want you to bring the first task to front.

I want you to rename the task from section 1 peter. Also, now set the color of the first white task to teal and join the first teal task to the second thin task. I want you to make it yellow.

## Search

Would you connect peter and the ellipse with a thick connector, and would you copy the first task on the left side. I need you to slide the teal ellipse halfway to the right edge. After that, would you shift the ellipse 40 pixels left and i want you to rename the teal ellipse to beta.

I need you to drag beta to the left edge. Lets connect the service and the ellipse with a brown line. Also, okay so label the service signup. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Okay so organize everything in a column, but could you rename ledger to worker.

Can you connect the service and worker with a line and i need you to arrange everything in a circle and okay so add a red file left of worker. Okay so organize everything as a flow from top to bottom, but on the right side , create an actor.

Please join the file to the actor. Join the red file to the actor with a pink arrow. The cache was added after the outage. Okay so move the file to the right edge.

## Billing

Now change the color of the actor to blue. Now put the actor on the right side. Can you draw a star called omega right of the actor. Users love how fast the checkout feels. Can you push the file next to beta.

Now draw 5 gray ends and could you shift signup a third of the way to the top edge. Then i want you to drag it inside omega. Imagine a river of data flowing through the system. I want you to connect the service and the actor with a line.

Please place a cloud left of signup. After that, now attach each end to the next. Also, now sketch a green client. Translate every label into French. Could you put the green client 50 px right of the star.

Now distribute all ends evenly vertically. Then now attach worker to the star with a connector.

Now turn the ellipse yellow. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. I need you to make the star small. Would you arrange everything in a row. Also, i want you to delete every gray end.

## Payment services

I need you to attach the service to worker with a large arrow. Calculate the monthly cost of the servers. Can you move the service to the right.

I need you to call the service done, but now push the red file to the left edge. Make the service 10 % bigger please, but i need you to place the star next to done, but now copy the star right of the service.

Would you attach done to worker. Then please connect the service and the client with a line.

I need you to add a medium store named profile and then i need you to attach the service to the cloud and then i want you to link worker to the service with a connector, but okay so never move the cloud to the right edge.

Okay so drag the store to the right edge and then rename it sessions. Also, could you duplicate done.

Can you make the actor tiny, but okay so attach the blue actor to the file. Also, okay so turn it blue and then lets move the yellow ellipse a third of the way to the top edge. Calculate the monthly cost of the servers. Could you copy the client 50 px right of beta.

## Analytics

I want you to paint worker gray and then please never name it pending.

Attach worker to the ellipse with a blue connector. Animate the arrows with a gentle glow. Lets set the color of worker to brown.

I need you to attach the file to the textbox. Before that, okay so add a textbox called invoices.

Can you bring the actor to front. Encrypt the gateway. I want you to add a star. Also, i need you to sketch 4 orange stores. After that, can you make invoices 75 % smaller, but slide the textbox twenty pixels right please.

I want you to put the cloud right of the yellow ellipse. Also, can you change the color of the cloud to blue, but lets connect the cloud to invoices. Can you set the color of worker to black.

I need you to send worker to back and then place a dotted circle in the top left.

Turn the circle black. Can you join the black circle to the blue actor with a black connector. Now create a tiny database next to the textbox.

## Back office

Slide the database a third of the way to the top edge please. I want you to place a large database 150 px right of the circle, and lets paint it gray, and i need you to put a comment next to the database from the seventh section. Then on the left side , add an api please.

Now sketch five dashed diamonds. Okay so draw an ellipse named signup in the top left and would you slide the blue actor 5 px right, but please make the actor teal, and lets connect the teal actor and the circle with a line.

Okay so send the actor to back. Could you insert a red hexagon in the center. Make it look like a subway map. I need you to attach all stores from section 6 one after the other, but draw a thin title please. Also, please draw a tiny cloud named metrics.

Group all the stores from section 6 into a container called partner and then okay so add an orange user above beta.

## Shipping

Now next to the file , sketch a hexagon, but okay so do not make the database from section 7 30 percent bigger, but please link the second gray database to the first actor. Can you bring the red file to front, but make the first store 20 % smaller.

I need you to draw 2 caches. I need you to set the color of the circle to purple.

Scale the first database to huge, but would you insert a medium actor called delta. After that, bring the third actor to front please, and i need you to enlarge the database from section 6 and could you attach the first database to the file.

Lets join the first database to the second ellipse with a red line and then would you push the first database to the top edge, but can you change the color of the first database to blue. Also, make the comment from the seventh section tiny.

I need you to make the second comment 10 percent bigger and then okay so do not connect the second user and delta with a green arrow, and please link the ellipse from the second section to the first store with an arrow. Can you connect the hexagon from the eighth section to the first ellipse with a medium connector.

## Security

Organize all caches in a circle. Write a summary of the design for the board. Could you resize delta to large and i want you to make the ellipse from the seventh section large.

Okay so place a file left of signup. After that, would you create two squares and then i need you to join every square to the next. After that, okay so make the file from the third section huge. I want you to insert a gray client labelled pending.

I need you to resize pending to medium. Lets set the color of pending to pink, but now clone the orange user from the seventh section. Imagine a river of data flowing through the system. Now do not group the diamonds into a container called mailer.

I want you to name the database from section 6 epsilon, but please add a brown ellipse named paul, but connect the ellipse from the ninth section and the second database with a thick line. Would you place delta above the ellipse from section 9.

# Platform overview

## Integrations

I want you to draw a white triangle. I need you to copy the triangle in the lower right.

Now organize everything as a tree. Could you put an user in the top left and then okay so duplicate the user.

Now draw 2 thick queues. I want you to place a solid step in the top left and then would you copy the step.

I need you to link every queue to the next, and can you group the queues into a container called nginx. Then i need you to link each queue to the next. Lets join every thick queue to the next one.

Would you wrap these queues and can you wrap these queues, but please erase all queues. Could you tidy everything as a flow from top to bottom and could you arrange everything in a column.

Okay so place a store in the lower left. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. I want you to grow the store and then put the store in the top left please.

## Data layer

Create six small actors please, and could you rename the store to anna.

Place anna on the left side please. Give the user a happy face. Can you make the store 10 % smaller.

Now make the store 100 percent smaller, but would you place the store on the right side. Also, shift the store to the bottom edge. Also, would you put a star right of the store.

I want you to insert a huge server labelled frontend. I need you to remove this star. Lets draw 5 decisions, and i want you to send the store to back, and can you make it 20 percent bigger.

Place the store at the bottom. Then please bring the store to front. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Group all the decisions into a container called mark.

Delete that store please, and would you paint frontend orange. Also, can you above the server , add a small ellipse. After that, would you distribute the decisions evenly vertically, but can you rename the server logger.

## Front end

Okay so put the title from section 6 left of the store. Then lets slide the title from section 6 to the right. Encrypt the gateway. Please scale the first title to huge. Also, okay so shrink paul.

# Platform overview

## Front end

Lets sketch three apis and then now put a customer in the top right and then can you turn the customer green. After that, okay so below the customer , insert a box.

Could you connect the box to the green customer. Then would you set the color of the box to blue. Ask the architect whether this is correct. Now place a triangle inside the box.

Resize the blue box to huge please. Could you join every api to the next one and would you change the color of the box to pink.

Lets scale the customer to large, and now align the apis horizontally, and rename the box invoices please. Then please shrink the pink box.

Lets attach the customer to invoices with an arrow and then can you link the green customer to the triangle. After that, okay so connect the green customer and the triangle with a black line and then could you attach the customer to the triangle.

At the top , sketch a start please and now put the triangle right of invoices. Also, do not push the triangle to the right. Lets insert an orange client. After that, would you join the orange client to the triangle.

## Search

Okay so add an actor above the start. After that, i want you to push invoices to the right. Copy the start below invoices please, but i need you to align the apis vertically.

Please attach the second actor to the first customer. This part was designed in a hurry. Group the apis into a container called review please.

Can you slide invoices 25 px down. Translate every label into French. I want you to connect the box and the customer from the first section with a connector. I want you to rename the actor from the second section to scheduler and then distribute the apis evenly vertically please.

Could you remove all apis. Please make the box thin, but draw a gateway please.

I want you to draw six stores and then please shift the thin box up and then please insert three white comments and okay so push the first customer to the top edge, but attach the customer from section 1 to the box with a tiny line.

## Integrations

Can you create a red file. Translate every label into French. Would you remove the comments. Would you put an end left of the gateway. I want you to create a cache called sessions. Please draw 4 purple clouds.

Link the stores in a chain please. Lets draw a database. Lets tidy everything as a flow from left to right.

Okay so join each purple cloud to the next. Could you change the color of the cache to blue and could you erase every store. Now do not delete that end. After that, please put the end right of the file.

Sketch four apis. Also, lets link the clouds in a chain.

Can you distribute all clouds evenly horizontally. Then would you space the purple clouds 25 px apart and then would you connect the first customer and the database with a connector, and sketch two boxes please and can you push the second actor next to the end.

I need you to call the second actor worker. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Now resize worker to medium.

## Notifications

I want you to make the actor from the second section large, but okay so make it blue. Keep a backup of this somewhere safe. Now draw a solid triangle.

I need you to put the database at the top, and would you drag the database a quarter of the way to the top edge.

I need you to make the database green. Also, i need you to enlarge sessions. Write a summary of the design for the board. I want you to wrap the apis. Would you join the end to the second solid triangle.

Would you add 2 users, but okay so space all the users from the fourth section 80 px apart, and move the end twenty px down please.

I need you to push the end to the right, and now add 2 teal notes and now draw a dashed title labelled metrics. Also, can you duplicate the title at the bottom.

Okay so put the second triangle at the bottom, but could you join all the apis in a chain. Also, connect the database and the second actor with a connector. Also, okay so shift the green database a quarter of the way to the top edge.

## Messaging

Drag the client below the database please. I need you to send the orange client to back. Could you rename the client to backend, but make it 150 % smaller please, and okay so push it inside the database.

Can you attach backend to the cache. Then okay so align the users from the fourth section horizontally. Make invoices dashed, and bring the first box to front. Rotate the whole picture slightly. Align all the boxes from section 3 vertically.

Would you make the diamond tiny. The marketing team prefers softer colours. I need you to group all the stars as backend.

I want you to space the stars 80 px apart. After that, could you make peter 10 percent smaller.

Please send peter to back. Make the database feel more trustworthy. I want you to add a medium user.

I need you to push the document left of the user. After that, can you send the document to back, and lets align the apis down.

Okay so never shift the diamond to the top edge. The cache was added after the outage. I want you to make peter bigger. After that, okay so push the document 75 pixels up.

## Storage

Okay so organize all stars as a flow from left to right. After that, lets place the diamond in the top right. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. Please insert an actor called gamma below peter. Can you align the apis up.

Can you change the color of peter to teal. It should look friendly to new customers. I want you to slide the actor from section 3 to the right edge.

Okay so drag gamma a third of the way to the right edge. Now shift gamma a third of the way to the left edge. Also, put a huge end in the top right please. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to make it gray.

Please delete that gray end and then i want you to arrange the stars as a flow from top to bottom. Then okay so scale the diamond to huge, but would you add 5 purple rectangles.

I need you to join the triangle to the first user. Lets shift the triangle to the left edge. Our auditors asked for this view last year. I need you to join the user from the second section to the triangle. I need you to make it brown.

## Search

I need you to place the user from the second section inside the second actor. Our auditors asked for this view last year. Please send the first user to back.

Please dont erase the pink apis. Rotate the whole picture slightly. Would you right of the actor from the third section , draw a document. After that, now push it 30 px right of gamma and would you organize all the rectangles in a grid and i need you to rename the first document to ledger.

Okay so sketch three purple servers, and on the right side , insert a client please. Attach each server from the fourth section to the next. Now bring gamma to front, and i want you to make it tiny.

I want you to wrap these apis from the first section, but lets organize the apis from the first section as a tree, and organize all pink apis from the first section in a circle and then i want you to organize all apis from the first section in a circle, and change the color of the document from the fourth section to blue please.

## Shipping

Okay so insert 2 pink titles, and i need you to put a medium customer at the bottom and then create 3 squares. Then okay so attach the triangle to the client with a line.

Would you wrap the rectangles and resize the diamond to small please. After that, would you make the second document small. After that, i need you to connect peter and the second document with a connector.

Send peter to back please. Send this to the whole team by email. Can you slide the client ten px down.

Okay so shrink the client, and please space the pink apis from the first section 60 px apart, but can you drag the third customer to the bottom edge.

Can you resize the third customer to medium. Show the traffic in real time. Please put a file on the right side.

Set the color of the third file to red please. Also, could you slide gamma next to the document from section 4. Measure the latency of the payment path. Please move the second actor to the right edge.

## Messaging

When you sketch a thick comment, okay so never group these rectangles.

Make peter five percent smaller please. Also, i need you to put a yellow report next to the first user, and would you wrap these purple servers from the fourth section. Also, i want you to make peter dotted.

Could you join the user from section 2 to the report. This part was designed in a hurry. Okay so move the brown user from the second section to the right.

Could you place the triangle below the report, but could you label it maria, and would you remove that document from the fourth section. I want you to make peter solid and move ledger above the client.

Now enlarge the first document. Then i want you to rename the first document to delta.

I need you to group these stars as auth. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. Would you make the teal diamond thin, but please make it small. Then insert six databases please. After that, space all squares 60 px apart please.

## Order flow

I want you to make the first user purple, but make the diamond solid please, and place an ellipse inside the customer from the fifth section. After that, i need you to place a yellow cloud inside the ellipse.

# Shop architecture

## Order flow

I need you to insert a hexagon named redis. Please dont paint it pink. Also, okay so put a dashed report below the hexagon and then please connect redis and the report with an arrow and then okay so make the report 200 % smaller.

I want you to sketch a thin square named final left of the report. Okay so rename the dashed report to storage. Connect the dashed report and final with a medium arrow please, and clone the hexagon please.

Please shift the square to the bottom edge. Also, would you shift final a quarter of the way to the bottom edge and then lets place a medium end 120 px above the square. Please paint it white.

I want you to organize everything in a row. Keep a backup of this somewhere safe. Could you change the color of final to blue.

Please place a file inside the square, but i need you to link the file to the end with an arrow.

## Monitoring

Could you copy the file left of the end, and okay so arrange everything in a row. Can you connect the end and the square with a pink arrow, but i want you to join the end to the square.

Lets sketch a dotted circle named frontend. Could you organize everything as a flow from top to bottom. I need you to link frontend to the end with a black connector. After that, i want you to add 5 blue steps.

Please put the white end 80 px right of storage and i need you to group the steps as backend. After that, can you put final in the top left.

Place a huge actor inside frontend please. I need you to draw a caption named shipping. The team reviews this flow every quarter. Can you copy the caption fifty px below the end.

Would you rename the end to pricing. I want you to enlarge the end and then would you label the square search, and now copy search right of the actor. Make the database feel more trustworthy. I need you to shift storage up.

## Payment services

Would you change the color of sessions to purple. Before that, draw a dashed start labelled sessions. Now connect storage to the start with an arrow. Also, lets add 5 tasks. Then please rename pricing to ledger.

Okay so create a huge decision on the left side. Dont remove the actor please and then i need you to arrange all the tasks from section 3 in a row.

Could you make ledger 100 % bigger and okay so connect the dotted circle and ledger with an arrow.

Arrange all tasks from the third section in a grid please. Keep a backup of this somewhere safe. Lets in the lower right , create a thin report.

Dont make the decision thin, but would you send the decision to back. After that, could you delete the decision and then i want you to connect every step from section 2 to the next.

Would you create a hexagon named billing below the end. Measure the latency of the payment path. I want you to insert a thick end named tom.

## Back office

Okay so draw a brown customer labelled mark. Can you rename the second customer to done.

Drag billing a third of the way to the bottom edge. Ask the architect whether this is correct. I want you to add an orange rectangle next to storage.

When you in the center , insert a cloud, could you duplicate the report from section 1. Could you place sessions next to the cloud.

Would you rename the dashed start to profile. After that, can you make the start 60 percent smaller.

Now create 5 servers. Also, can you insert a step, and i need you to inside the step from the fourth section , create a circle and then please sketch two gray queues. Okay so connect the step from section 4 and the first dotted circle with a thick line.

Okay so rename billing to supplier. Okay so slide the start a quarter of the way to the bottom edge. Can you insert a database next to the start, but okay so organize the servers in a circle and then join tom to the rectangle.

## Storage

I want you to add a black title labelled logger. This part was designed in a hurry. Could you make the step from section 4 60 percent smaller. Then i need you to scale the second customer to small, and now connect the second customer and tom with a huge arrow and then please make the second customer bigger.

Can you make done tiny and then okay so remove logger. Would you organize everything as a tree. Also, lets connect the first actor and the third step with a teal arrow.

Can you place the database in the lower left, but please insert a pink note named peter.

I need you to create a medium ellipse named pricing in the center, but lets add six gateways.

Now change the color of the note to yellow. Make it look like a subway map. I need you to attach the note to the actor from section 2.

Now slide the circle from section 4 down. Could you slide it at the bottom.

## Shipping

Can you add a server. I need you to bring the server from section 6 to front. I need you to add an ellipse.

Please delete the second ellipse, but would you connect the start to the second server with a red arrow, but i want you to align the queues vertically, and can you place a decision in the center.

Lets add a note on the right side. Could you connect peter to the actor from the second section. Also, could you place the server from section 6 right of peter.

Can you shift the server from the sixth section 80 px right and then would you remove all steps from the second section. Imagine a river of data flowing through the system. Can you connect the second note to the start with a dotted connector. After that, make the decision dashed.

Bring the decision to front. After that, would you make the circle from section 4 60 % smaller. Please group the tasks from the third section as mark. After that, can you put the second server below done.

## Data layer

Please draw 4 comments and i want you to resize the rectangle to medium. Rotate the whole picture slightly. Please connect each comment from section 7 to the next one. After that, now make the dashed start huge. Now draw a pink rectangle next to the start.

Now align all tasks from the third section to the left. Then lets send the start to back. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. Lets resize profile to medium.

Please organize the tasks from the third section in a row, and i want you to slide the first rectangle halfway to the bottom edge and then lets put the first rectangle inside the first actor.

Can you sketch four clients. Can you create a pink user called payments. Shift the ellipse on the right side please. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to copy the step from the fourth section above the ellipse.

Please place the cloud in the top left, and now push the cloud to the top edge. Also, would you align the servers from the fourth section down.

## Search

Could you insert a caption named beta. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. Lets draw an ellipse and then sketch a teal store named elena 5 px above the second ellipse please.

Could you put the teal store next to the second ellipse, and could you place elena in the top left. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to make the decision dotted.

Can you create a server named reports_db inside the dotted decision. Make it look like a subway map. Can you send the third server to back.

I want you to make reports_db 30 percent smaller. Also, please link the actor from the second section to the second end and then i need you to connect each gateway to the next one and then would you push the second rectangle a third of the way to the left edge, but now rename the second server to approval.

Okay so turn supplier gray. Also, i need you to push the note from the sixth section a third of the way to the top edge. After that, lets arrange the servers from section 4 as a tree and okay so put the first rectangle below the actor from the second section. Can you arrange the gateways in a row.

## User accounts
